item.tib: zab lam mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzogs ma rgyud gsas mkhar sde lnga'i rgyud las las byang dga' dbang gter chen
item.coloph: bdag 'dra ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi ma'am bdud 'dul gsang sngags grags pas gyim shod shel le rgya gar (skar) nas spyan drangs te/ slar gangs can chos srid kyi bdag po ra sgreng ho thog spral pa'i yongs 'dzin gsan su gcig thu da la'i bla ma sogs/ ris bral rgyal bstan gang la thugs brtse gnang ba (ba'i) skyes chen du ma nas bka' yi bskul ma gnang ba bzhin shing phag 'bras ldan zla ba'i tshes bzang por mkha' 'gro'i brda ris la zhal bshus shing yi ge dang po'i byed po 'gru bon g.yung drung dar rgyas pas zab lam gsang chen gyi snying po rtogs pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
